page.layout: One text page with one column of running text. Two syllogisms are set into the column, each with its mnemonic letters at the left and its term numbers in braces at the right. No marginal notes. A catchword stands at the lower right. Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: affirmatiua conclusio universalis negatiua co-gitur: Semper enim (ut ante diximus) ad de-teriorem se partem applicat conclusio. veluti,
main_text.l: rent Ergo nullus Philosophus est avarus. 3
main_text.p: Quod est huius Syllogismi firmamentum? Locus est ex genere ad speciem, cuius hoc firmamentum est. Quod generi repugnat, idem speciei quoque repugnat. Nam propositio repugnantium affectione continetur: assumptio generis.

Quis est tertius? Cùm è propositione universali affirmativa, & assumptione particulari affirmativa, conclusio particularis affirmativa cogitur. Semper enim (ut dixi) deteriorē partem conclusio sequitur. veluti,
main_text.l: j Ergo quædam artes sunt fugienda. 3
main_text.p: Quodnam huius firmamentum est? Locus est ex genere ad speciem, cuius hoc firmamé-tum est: Quod generis est consequens, idem quoque speciei est consequens. Nam propo-sitio consequentiū ratione continetur: assum-ptio, generis.
Quis est quartus? Cùm ex proportione universali negativa, assumptione particulari affirmativa, conclusio particularis negativa co-gitur. veluti:

page.notes: The two syllogisms are drawn with braces. In the first, the numbers 2, 1, 3 and 4 sit at the ends of the braces, and the brace in the middle of the first line is a brace glyph, not a letter. In the second, the brace also carries 2, 1, 3 and 4. The mnemonic labels "Ce / la / rent" (Celarent) and "Da / ri / j" (Darii) are printed at the left of the lines. A small mark stands under "Quod" near the bottom centre; it is not a letter. The printed long s (eft, fe, fapiens and similar) has been written as s. Printed u and v have been normalised to the vowel or consonant form.
